measure:0.en: Master Qingwu handed me a length of reed and told me to *measure* the distance between my breath and the word I was trying to speak. 'Too close and it burns,' she said, 'too far and it sleeps.' I pressed the reed to my lips, found the middle distance, and the word rose from my throat like warm water. A thin line of mist curled up from the ink stone and hung in the air.
measure:0.cnHint: 师尊让我用芦苇杆____呼吸与字之间的距离，以找到恰当的发声位置。
measure:0.hook: The mist formed a narrow arrow pointing toward the sealed inner door.
measure:0.line: '*Measure* the space between your breath and the word — not too close, not too far.'

recommend:0.en: Xiaoxing spread three scrolls before me and said she could only *recommend* one to start. 'The word for wind is beautiful but proud,' she warned, 'the word for water is gentle but deep, and the word for earth is slow but it never forgets.' I reached for the word for water, and the moment my fingers touched the scroll, a low hum rose through the floorboards.
recommend:0.cnHint: 师妹将三卷典籍摆在我面前，说她只能____其中一卷作为入门之选。
recommend:0.hook: The hum grew louder, as if the mountain itself had an opinion.
recommend:0.line: 'I *recommend* the word for water — it will not rush you, and it will not leave you.'

resource:0.en: 'A word, once learned, becomes a *resource* you carry in your very bones,' Master Qingwu told us as we sat in a circle on the cold stone floor. 'It costs nothing to speak, yet it can lift a man above the clouds.' She opened her palm and a small light rested there, steady as a lamp. Then the light split into eight — one for each of us — and drifted to hover above our heads.
resource:0.cnHint: 师尊说，一个真正掌握的字会成为弟子骨髓里的____，随时可用。
resource:0.hook: The light above my head pulsed once, as though it recognized something in me.
resource:0.line: 'Every word you master is a *resource* that no one can ever take from you.'

specific:0.en: Shen Wujiu corrected my posture for the third time. 'There is a *specific* way to hold your shoulders when you speak a word of flight,' he said patiently, 'and if one joint is wrong, you will rise only to fall.' I adjusted, spoke the syllable, and felt my heels lift a single breath above the floor. A crack of pale light appeared along the window frame, though the sun had already set.
specific:0.cnHint: 师兄说，念飞翔之字时，肩膀有一种____的姿势，差一点都不行。
specific:0.hook: The pale light spread slowly, as if dawn had arrived hours too early.
specific:0.line: 'There is a *specific* position for every word — learn the shape before you learn the sound.'

policy:1.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a narrow scroll at the gate of the outer courtyard. 'The sect has one *policy* above all others,' she said, her voice steady as stone. 'No disciple may speak a healing word without first proving they understand its cost.' I pressed my hands together and bowed, feeling the weight of every word I had yet to learn.
policy:1.cnHint: 师尊在庭院门口宣布门派的____：弟子须先懂代价，方可使用治愈之言。
policy:1.hook: Behind her, a second scroll began to unroll on its own.
policy:1.line: 'Our *policy* is simple: master the cost before you speak the cure.'

industry:1.en: Shen Wujiu led me through the Craft Terrace, where senior disciples worked without rest. Hammers of pure sound shaped word-stones; brushes wove syllables into living thread. 'Talent fades,' he said quietly, 'but *industry* does not.' I watched their steady hands and understood that even here, above the clouds, nothing came without labour.
industry:1.cnHint: 师兄带我参观劳作台，告诉我天赋易逝，唯有____长久。
industry:1.hook: One word-stone cracked down the middle without anyone touching it.
industry:1.line: '*Industry*, not talent, is what keeps a disciple alive on this mountain.'

concern:1.en: Xiaoxing found me sitting alone at the cliff's edge, staring down into the white sea of clouds below. 'Your *concern* shows on your face,' she said softly, settling beside me. 'Every new disciple fears the first test.' I said nothing, but I was grateful she had noticed. The clouds shifted, and for a moment I saw something dark moving beneath them.
concern:1.cnHint: 师妹注意到我脸上的____，轻声安慰初入门的弟子都会害怕第一次考验。
concern:1.hook: The dark shape beneath the clouds rose slowly toward the mountain.
concern:1.line: 'Your *concern* is written all over your face — you are not alone in this.'

present:1.en: On the morning of my first full day, Master Qingwu called all new disciples to the Stone Garden. She held up a single jade leaf. 'The past is a root; the future is a branch. But only the *present* moment holds living water.' She pressed the leaf into my palm and closed my fingers around it. It was warm, as though it had been breathing.
present:1.cnHint: 师尊在石园中教导新弟子：只有____这一刻才蕴含活水。
present:1.hook: The jade leaf pulsed once, then went still.
present:1.line: 'Live in the *present* — the word you speak now is the only one that heals.'

claim:1.en: A senior disciple stepped forward before the assembled sect and pointed at Shen Wujiu. 'I *claim* the right to challenge his rank,' the disciple said loudly. Shen Wujiu did not move. Master Qingwu raised one hand and silence fell like snow. 'Rights may be claimed,' she said, 'but they must also be earned.' No one spoke again for a long time.
claim:1.cnHint: 一名高年资弟子____有权挑战师兄的位阶，但师尊提醒权利还需靠实力赢得。
claim:1.hook: Shen Wujiu's word-badge dimmed at the edges, then brightened sharply.
claim:1.line: 'I *claim* the right of challenge — let the words decide who stands higher.'

half:1.en: Xiaoxing handed me a small clay bowl. Inside lay a single word-seed, split cleanly down the centre. 'You may only plant *half* today,' she explained. 'The other half must rest until the next moon, or the growth will consume itself.' I held the two pieces carefully and wondered what word would bloom from something already broken before it began.
half:1.cnHint: 师妹告诉我今天只能种下词种的____，另一半须等下次月圆才可种下。
half:1.hook: The resting half trembled in my palm as if it were listening.
half:1.line: 'Plant only *half* now — rush the other half and you will lose both.'

successful:1.en: Master Qingwu posted the results of the first trial on the gate pillar at dawn. I searched the list with cold fingers. My name was there. I had been *successful*. Shen Wujiu clapped me once on the shoulder without a word. Xiaoxing smiled the way a candle smiles when wind passes and does not kill it. Then the gate behind us creaked open by itself.
successful:1.cnHint: 第一次考验结果公布，我查到自己的名字，终于____了，师兄师妹各自给予了鼓励。
successful:1.hook: The gate opened onto a corridor none of us had seen before.
successful:1.line: 'You were *successful* — but the door that just opened was not part of any trial.'

access:1.en: Shen Wujiu stopped me at the entrance to the Inner Word Library. 'Only disciples who have passed the second seal have *access* to these shelves,' he said. I looked through the latticed door at rows of glowing scrolls and felt a pull in my chest, as if the words inside already knew my name. I stepped back, but my shadow on the floor leaned forward.
access:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我只有通过第二印的弟子才有____进入内藏书楼的权限，但我的影子却向前倾去。
access:1.hook: My shadow stayed leaning toward the door even as I walked away.
access:1.line: 'Without the seal, you have no *access* — and those scrolls do not wait quietly.'

positive:1.en: The outer courtyard smelled of morning mist and pine. Master Qingwu walked between the stone herb beds, testing each disciple with a single question. When my turn came, I named the word without hesitation. Her reaction was *positive* — a slow nod that carried more weight than any spoken praise. Around us, the clouds shifted silver.
positive:1.cnHint: 在外院的清晨测验中，我准确说出了那个词，师尊给出了____的回应。
positive:1.hook: Then her eyes moved to the sky, and her nod faded.
positive:1.line: 'Your answer is *positive*; now show me you believe it yourself.'

economic:1.en: Shen Wujiu spread a long scroll across the market-bridge rail, its columns filled with herb prices and trade routes between the floating peaks. 'Every word has an *economic* value,' he said, tapping a figure. 'Name it too cheaply and it loses power. Name it too dearly and no one will carry it.' I stared at the numbers, trying to see the mountain behind them.
economic:1.cnHint: 师兄在集市木桥上展开账册，解释词语的____价值。
economic:1.hook: One column, I noticed, had been crossed out in red ink.
economic:1.line: 'Even a rare word has an *economic* price — and someone is always willing to pay it.'

link:1.en: Between the East Peak and the West Peak stretched a single rope bridge, each plank carved with a binding word. Xiaoxing called this the *link* that kept the two summits from drifting apart in storm season. She touched a plank and the carving glowed faint blue. I reached for the next one, but she caught my wrist gently. 'Not that word. Not yet.'
link:1.cnHint: 小星告诉我，连接两座山峰的绳桥是维系它们的____。
link:1.hook: The plank she had warned me away from was already cracking down the middle.
link:1.line: 'This bridge is the *link* between us — do not step on a word you cannot carry.'

produce:1.en: We gathered in the herb garden at the cliff's edge, where the wind smelled of rain about to fall. Master Qingwu showed us how a single spoken formula could *produce* a faint warmth in the soil, coaxing a seed to push through stone. I tried three times. On the third, a thin green shoot appeared. My hands were shaking when I looked up.
produce:1.cnHint: 师尊示范如何用一句咒语____出让种子破石而出的暖意。
produce:1.hook: The shoot was growing far faster than any seed should.
produce:1.line: 'Speak with care — a careless word can *produce* something you are not ready to hold.'

teach:1.en: The lesson took place on the open landing stone, wind cutting across from the north. Master Qingwu stood with her back to the drop, perfectly still. 'I will *teach* you only once,' she said. 'After that, the word teaches itself, if you are honest with it.' She spoke the formula aloud. Every disciple heard a different thing. We compared notes in silence after she left.
teach:1.cnHint: 师尊站在悬崖石台上，说她只____一次，之后需要我们自行领悟。
teach:1.hook: My notes did not match any of the others, not even by a single sound.
teach:1.line: 'I will *teach* you the word once; what you do with it is your own choice.'

worth:1.en: Shen Wujiu and I walked the lower market path, where disciples traded copied scrolls and bottled mist. He paused at a stall selling a single dried leaf sealed in glass. The price was steep. 'Is it *worth* it?' I asked. He looked at the leaf for a long moment. 'Only if you already know half the word it holds,' he said, and walked on without buying it.
worth:1.cnHint: 在山市小摊前，我问师兄那片叶子是否____那个价钱。
worth:1.hook: The vendor smiled at our retreating backs in a way that felt like a warning.
worth:1.line: 'Ask yourself if it is *worth* the cost before you speak the word it contains.'

common:1.en: In the courtyard where new disciples gathered, Xiaoxing pointed to a grey herb growing between the paving stones. 'This is the most *common* plant on all the peaks,' she said. 'Everyone steps on it. No one studies it.' She crushed a leaf and held it under my nose. The scent opened something at the back of my mind, sharp and old. I had smelled it before, somewhere I could not name.
common:1.cnHint: 小星指着石缝里最____的草药，说没人认真研究它。
common:1.hook: That night the same scent drifted under my door, though no herb grew nearby.
common:1.line: 'Do not ignore a *common* thing — the oldest words hide in the plainest places.'

daily:1.en: Each morning we swept the stone path from the gate to the main hall — a *daily* task that felt too simple to matter. Shen Wujiu told me the sweeping was itself a formula, that the rhythm of the broom wrote a slow word on the ground, one stroke each day. It would take a full year to finish it. I looked down at the pale marks already in the stone and felt the length of that year settle on my shoulders.
daily:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，每天扫地其实是在书写一个咒语，这是我们____的功课。
daily:1.hook: Someone had swept the path twice that morning, and the marks were wrong.
daily:1.line: 'Your *daily* task is never just a task — every motion is a stroke of the word.'

determine:1.en: At dawn, Master Qingwu set three glowing herbs on the stone path and folded her hands. 'Before you touch a single leaf,' she said, 'you must *determine* which one holds cold energy and which holds warmth.' I knelt, breathed slowly, and let my fingers hover. The middle herb hummed like a distant bell.
determine:1.cnHint: 师尊要求我在触碰之前，先____出每株灵草蕴含的属性。
determine:1.hook: The herb I chose began to tremble on its own.
determine:1.line: 'You must *determine* the nature of each herb before the sun clears the peak.'

response:1.en: Shen Wujiu called out the word 'ascend' and the stone steps lit one by one. He turned to me, waiting. I opened my mouth and shaped the same sound. For a breath, nothing happened. Then, in slow *response*, the final step glowed — faint but real — and the mountain path opened before me.
response:1.cnHint: 当我念出那个字时，石阶终于给出了____，为我亮起了光。
response:1.hook: A second glow appeared where no step had ever been carved.
response:1.line: 'The mountain gives its *response* only to a clear and honest voice.'

search:1.en: A sacred word had gone missing from the sect's open-air library. Xiaoxing and I began a careful *search* among the floating jade tablets, reading each one aloud under the pale morning sky. The clouds below stirred as if listening. We found only silence where the word should have been.
search:1.cnHint: 我和同门师妹在空中藏书阁里____那个失落的灵字，却一无所获。
search:1.hook: One tablet shone briefly, then went completely dark.
search:1.line: 'Our *search* will mean nothing if the word has already been carried away by the wind.'

regard:1.en: Shen Wujiu had mastered forty healing words before the age of twenty. The older disciples *regarded* him with quiet admiration, stepping aside when he passed the herb pavilion each morning. I watched this and understood: in the Cloud Sea Sect, words earned respect far faster than years did.
regard:1.cnHint: 师兄已掌握四十个疗愈灵字，门中众人都____他为不凡之才。
regard:1.hook: That morning, Shen Wujiu walked past without stopping — and his shadow moved the wrong way.
regard:1.line: 'I *regard* every word you learn as a promise you make to the mountain.'

true:1.en: Xiaoxing pressed a pale seed into my hand and told me to speak the word for 'grow.' I said it three times, but the seed lay still. She shook her head gently. 'The word is *true* only when you believe what you are saying,' she said. On my fourth try, a green thread rose from my palm.
true:1.cnHint: 师妹告诉我，只有内心____诚的时候，灵字才会生效。
true:1.hook: The green thread kept rising long after it should have stopped.
true:1.line: 'A *true* word and a spoken word are not always the same thing.'

depend:1.en: 'Your ability to fly,' Master Qingwu said, standing at the cliff's open edge, 'does not *depend* on the strength of your voice. It depends on the stillness beneath it.' She stepped back and looked at me steadily. The clouds far below shifted into the shape of open hands.
depend:1.cnHint: 师尊说，飞行的能力并不____于声音的强弱，而在于内心的宁静。
depend:1.hook: The open-hand shape in the clouds slowly began to close.
depend:1.line: 'How far you rise will *depend* entirely on how quiet you can become.'

expensive:1.en: At the mountain market, I saw a tiny vial of condensed cloud-word essence priced beyond a full year of sect allowance. Shen Wujiu stood beside me and said quietly, 'The most *expensive* things here are not always the most powerful.' He bought a plain dried leaf instead and handed it to me without a word.
expensive:1.cnHint: 在山间集市，我看到一瓶灵字精华价格高得离谱——师兄却说____的东西未必最强。
expensive:1.hook: The plain dried leaf in my hand began to glow the moment we left the market.
expensive:1.line: 'Something this *expensive* should make you ask who decided what it is worth.'

explain:1.en: The mountain path was narrow and wrapped in morning mist. Shen Wujiu stopped beside a carved stone tablet and turned to me. 'A new disciple must learn to read the old signs,' he said. He began to *explain* each symbol slowly, his finger tracing the lines as the clouds below us shifted and hummed.
explain:1.cnHint: 师兄在石碑旁____每一个古老符文的含义，晨雾中云海低沉地涌动。
explain:1.hook: But one symbol had no explanation, and Shen Wujiu's hand went still.
explain:1.line: 'Let me *explain* what this stone has warned every disciple for a hundred years.'

examine:1.en: Master Qingwu knelt beside the pale herb growing at the cliff's edge. She did not touch it. Instead, she asked me to *examine* the color of its leaves and the shape of its roots, watching my face as I leaned close. Below us, the sea of clouds rolled without sound, vast and patient.
examine:1.cnHint: 师尊要我仔细____悬崖边那株草药的叶色与根形，云海在脚下无声翻涌。
examine:1.hook: Then she asked what I smelled, and her eyes grew dark with concern.
examine:1.line: '*Examine* the roots before you speak — your first answer will not come again.'

influence:1.en: Xiaoxing and I sat on the outer ledge, watching cloud patterns drift between the peaks. She explained that certain spoken words could *influence* the wind currents near our mountain, bending them gently the way a hand shapes water. I tried one word aloud. A small gust rose, warm and willing.
influence:1.cnHint: 师妹解释说，某些特定的词语能够____山间的气流走向，我轻声试了一个词。
influence:1.hook: Somewhere deep in the sect hall, a bell rang once without being struck.
influence:1.line: 'The right word can *influence* clouds the way kindness shapes a friend.'

argue:1.en: Outside the herb store at the mountain market, Shen Wujiu began to *argue* with the old keeper over the freshness of a batch of wind-root leaves. His voice stayed low but firm. I stood at his side, listening to the logic beneath each calm sentence. The keeper finally nodded and offered a better bundle.
argue:1.cnHint: 师兄在山市药铺外与老掌柜____风根叶的新鲜程度，声音平静却立场坚定。
argue:1.hook: As we walked away, the keeper stared at Shen Wujiu's back with an expression I could not name.
argue:1.line: 'I do not *argue* to win — I argue because the herb matters to someone sick.'

pass:1.en: We walked the bridge of white stone that connected the outer peak to the sect's inner hall. A cold wind tried to push me sideways, but I leaned into it and kept my steps steady. To *pass* this bridge on one's first day was considered a sign of quiet courage, Xiaoxing had told me that morning.
pass:1.cnHint: 师妹告诉我，第一天就能顺利____这座白石桥，被认为是内心沉稳的象征。
pass:1.hook: I reached the far side, and the door behind me sealed itself without a sound.
pass:1.line: 'Few disciples manage to *pass* the bridge when the valley wind is this sharp.'

serious:1.en: Master Qingwu stood at the peak where new disciples received their first word-herb. Her face was *serious* in the way that a clear sky before rain is serious — calm, but carrying weight. She handed me a single leaf, dark green and faintly warm. 'Do not lose this,' she said. 'Not today.'
serious:1.cnHint: 师尊神情____地将一枚温热的深绿叶片交到我手中，叮嘱我今天万万不可丢失。
serious:1.hook: The leaf pulsed once against my palm, as if it already knew something I did not.
serious:1.line: 'Be *serious* with your first word-herb — it has already chosen to trust you.'

despite:1.en: *Despite* the heavy fog that morning, Xiaoxing led me up the outer stairs without slowing down. She said she had walked this path so many times that her feet remembered it even when her eyes could not. I followed the sound of her steps, and the clouds parted just enough to show the peak above.
despite:1.cnHint: ____浓厚的晨雾，师妹毫不减速地引领我攀上外侧石阶，云雾在峰顶稍稍散开。
despite:1.hook: But the stairs above the fog line had not been there yesterday, I was certain of it.
despite:1.line: '*Despite* the fog, the mountain always shows itself to those who keep moving.'

express:1.en: After the morning lesson, I stood alone at the edge of the platform, trying to find the right word for what I felt. Shen Wujiu had told me that in our sect, to *express* a true feeling clearly was itself a form of spiritual practice, as real as any herb or formula. I opened my mouth, and the clouds below seemed to lean in.
express:1.cnHint: 师兄说，在云海宗，能够清晰地____内心真实的感受，本身就是一种修行。
express:1.hook: The word I finally spoke lit a faint gold line across the nearest cloud, then vanished.
express:1.line: 'To *express* what you truly feel is the first formula every disciple must learn.'

career:1.en: On the outer terrace of the Cloud Sea Sect, I watched Shen Wujiu trace glowing herb-names across a stone board. 'Every disciple must choose a path,' Master Qingwu said softly. A long *career* of healing or fighting lay ahead — but the clouds below us turned suddenly dark.
career:1.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，在云海门，每位弟子都必须为自己的____做出选择。
career:1.hook: The dark clouds rose faster than any storm should.
career:1.line: 'A *career* chosen in haste may never be undone,' Master Qingwu warned.

medium:1.en: Xiaoxing pressed her palm to the hollow spirit-stone at the mountain gate. The stone was a *medium* through which the sect's oldest formulas passed like breath through reeds. A faint map of roots and stars bloomed inside it, and then, without warning, one branch went black.
medium:1.cnHint: 小星发现，那块灵石是传递功法的____，但其中一道脉络突然熄灭了。
medium:1.hook: A dead branch in the stone had never been seen before.
medium:1.line: 'This stone is the *medium* between us and the first ancestors,' Xiaoxing whispered.

office:1.en: Near the cliffside path, a small pavilion served as Master Qingwu's *office* — open to wind on three sides, with scrolls stacked like sleeping clouds. I arrived to report my first herb-harvest, but the scrolls had been moved, the low table overturned, and the master was nowhere to be seen.
office:1.cnHint: 我去师尊的____汇报，却发现那里一片凌乱，师尊不见踪影。
office:1.hook: A single scroll lay open, still smoking at its edges.
office:1.line: 'Meet me at my *office* before the second bell,' Master Qingwu had said.

culture:1.en: Shen Wujiu led me through the Outer Garden, where rare spirit-herbs grew in careful rows. 'The *culture* of our sect,' he said, 'is rooted in these plants as much as in any formula.' Each leaf held a word; each word held a world. One plant, I noticed, had no word at all.
culture:1.cnHint: 师兄解释说，宗门的____体现在每一株灵草之中，但我发现有一株草上什么也没有。
culture:1.hook: A nameless herb in a sect of names was impossible.
culture:1.line: 'Without these herbs, the *culture* of the Cloud Sea Sect would vanish,' Shen Wujiu said.

college:1.en: The Hall of First Words was what older disciples called the *college* of the sect — a wide stone courtyard where new members learned the basic herb-formulas. I stood at its gate on my first morning, ink-brush in hand, and heard the courtyard go completely silent the moment I stepped inside.
college:1.cnHint: 我第一次走进宗门的____，脚刚踏入，整个院子里所有声音突然消失了。
college:1.hook: Silence in the Hall of First Words meant only one thing.
college:1.line: 'The *college* of this sect has stood for a thousand years,' Master Qingwu said quietly.

value:1.en: At the market terrace below the third peak, disciples traded herb-names for supplies. Xiaoxing held up a small vial of morning-dew script. 'The *value* of this formula is not silver,' she told the trader, 'but safe passage through the lower clouds.' The trader's hand trembled as he reached for it.
value:1.cnHint: 小星用一瓶晨露文字去交换物资，声称它真正的____不是银钱，而是通行的安全。
value:1.hook: The trader had seen that script fail once before.
value:1.line: 'You do not know the true *value* of what you carry,' Xiaoxing said.

connection:1.en: Master Qingwu drew two herb-signs in the air, and a thread of pale light joined them. 'Feel the *connection*,' she said. I reached out and the thread passed through my fingers like cold water, leaving a single character burning on my palm. It was not a word I had ever been taught.
connection:1.cnHint: 师尊让我感受两株灵草之间的____，但那道光在我手上留下了一个我从未学过的字。
connection:1.hook: Unknown words on a disciple's palm were said to be a warning.
connection:1.line: 'Every herb has a *connection* to the one it was planted beside,' Master Qingwu said.

story:1.en: On the carved outer wall of the main hall, every stone block held a *story* — a scene of past disciples mastering a word and rising into the sky. Shen Wujiu pointed to the highest block, nearly hidden by cloud. The figure carved there had no face and carried no herb at all.
story:1.cnHint: 主殿外墙的每块石头都刻着一个____，但最高处那块的人物没有面孔，也没有灵草。
story:1.hook: A faceless carving on a sect wall was never an accident.
story:1.line: 'Every *story* on this wall ends with flight,' Shen Wujiu said, 'except one.'

conduct:1.en: On the outer terrace of Cloud Sea Sect, Master Qingwu watched the new disciples gather below the stone steps. She studied each face with calm, measuring eyes. 'Your *conduct* here speaks before your words do,' she said. A silence fell, heavy as morning mist rolling in from the sea of clouds.
conduct:1.cnHint: 清雾师尊在石阶上观察新弟子，提醒他们的____比言语更能说明一切。
conduct:1.hook: One disciple's eyes flickered — and Master Qingwu noticed.
conduct:1.line: 'Your *conduct* on this mountain will follow you everywhere.'

reveal:1.en: Shen Wujiu led me along the cliff path where rare herb-lights glow at dawn. He pressed his palm to a mossy wall, and a hidden gate swung open to *reveal* a garden of floating, glowing herbs. My breath caught. Each plant hummed a different word, soft as wind across still water.
reveal:1.cnHint: 无咎师兄触碰石壁，一扇暗门打开，____出一座漂浮草药的秘密花园。
reveal:1.hook: At the garden's centre, one herb burned a cold, warning red.
reveal:1.line: 'Let the mountain *reveal* its secrets only to the patient.'

powerful:1.en: Outside the sect gate, traders from the lower valleys offered common herbs for sale. I paused at a small jar holding a single dark root. Xiaoxing pulled my sleeve. 'That root is more *powerful* than it looks,' she whispered. Above us, the wind shifted, and the clouds parted like slow curtains.
powerful:1.cnHint: 小星低声告诉我，摊位上那根貌不惊人的草药其实非常____。
powerful:1.hook: The trader smiled too quickly when he heard her warning.
powerful:1.line: 'A *powerful* herb kept in the wrong hands is a sleeping storm.'

push:1.en: Master Qingwu called us to the wide training terrace before the sun had fully risen. 'Today's *push* is not of the body,' she said, 'but of the mind.' She set twelve stone tablets in a circle and told us each word carved there must be spoken correctly before noon. A hawk cried overhead.
push:1.cnHint: 清雾师尊宣布，今天有一项重大____，要求弟子们在正午前读出所有石碑上的字。
push:1.hook: A crack formed in one tablet before any of us had spoken.
push:1.line: 'This final *push* will show us who truly wishes to rise.'

wonder:1.en: I sat at the edge of the outer cliff as evening came, watching the sea of clouds turn gold and rose below my feet. A slow *wonder* filled my chest — that words alone, spoken with true intent, could lift a person above these clouds. Xiaoxing sat beside me without a sound.
wonder:1.cnHint: 坐在悬崖边望着云海，我心中充满了____，感叹语言竟有如此神奇的力量。
wonder:1.hook: Below the clouds, something large moved, and it was rising.
wonder:1.line: 'Look at this *wonder*, and tell me words are not alive.'

design:1.en: Shen Wujiu spread a broad leaf on the ground and began to mark it with a thin herb-ink brush. He was working to *design* a new arrangement of word-formulas, one that could guide healing force around a wound rather than straight through it. The leaf shimmered faintly with each careful stroke.
design:1.cnHint: 无咎师兄正在用草药墨水____一套新的字诀阵列，让治愈之力能绕过伤处流动。
design:1.hook: On the fifth stroke, the leaf let out a single, soft cry.
design:1.line: 'We must *design* each formula as if lives depend on its shape.'

exercise:1.en: Each morning, disciples were required to *exercise* on the wide stone terrace, speaking word-formulas aloud while moving through slow, deliberate poses. Master Qingwu walked among us, correcting breath and stance. The clouds below shifted with every word we voiced, as if the mountain itself were listening and responding.
exercise:1.cnHint: 每天清晨，弟子们在石台上边____边大声吟诵字诀，清雾师尊穿行其间逐一纠正。
exercise:1.hook: Today my voice made the nearest cloud rise three full steps.
exercise:1.line: '*Exercise* your words daily — a still tongue learns nothing.'

space:1.en: Beyond the outer garden wall, a narrow *space* between two leaning boulders opened onto a hidden ledge. I found it by accident, following a soft hum only I seemed to hear. The ledge hung over nothing but open sky and cloud. A single herb grew there, rooted in pure air, needing no soil.
space:1.cnHint: 两块巨石之间有一处狭小的____，里面藏着一处悬空岩台，生长着一株扎根于空气的草药。
space:1.hook: The herb turned toward me as if it had been waiting.
space:1.line: 'Guard this *space* — not everything sacred needs a door.'

real:1.en: The outer path wound between stone lanterns, each one carved with a word too old to read. Shen Wujiu stopped beside me and pointed at the lowest lantern. 'That glow is *real* power,' he said quietly. 'Not the kind that fades when the wind turns.' I pressed my fingertip to the stone and felt a faint warmth rise into my palm.
real:1.cnHint: 师兄指着石灯告诉我，那种____的力量与表面的假象完全不同。
real:1.hook: Behind us, the lantern we had touched went suddenly dark.
real:1.line: 'That glow is *real* power, not the kind that fades when the wind turns.'

talk:1.en: Master Qingwu called us to the open terrace at dawn. The sea of clouds stretched below like a white river. She did not shout or lecture; her *talk* was soft, each word placed like a herb on a clean cloth. When she finished, the air still held the shape of her sentences, humming faintly above the stone rail.
talk:1.cnHint: 清雾师尊在露台上与我们进行了一次____，每个字都轻柔而有力。
talk:1.hook: Then she turned away, and the cloud below us changed color.
talk:1.line: 'This *talk* holds more weight than a hundred loud lessons,' Xiaoxing whispered beside me.

energy:1.en: Xiaoxing knelt at the base of the old pine on the outer ridge, both hands pressed flat to the bark. She was learning to read the tree's pulse. 'Every living thing holds *energy*,' she told me without turning her head. 'Our words are just a way of asking it to move.' A slow golden light crept up the pine's roots from the soil.
energy:1.cnHint: 小星在山脊松树下练习感受万物的____，试图用言语引导它流动。
energy:1.hook: The light reached the highest branch, and one needle fell straight down with no wind at all.
energy:1.line: 'Every living thing holds *energy*, and our words are a way of asking it to move.'

plan:1.en: Shen Wujiu spread a paper map on the flat rock near the sect gate, holding the corners down with stones. He had marked three herb gardens with small red circles. 'This is my *plan* for the coming month,' he said, tracing a path with one finger. 'Each garden teaches a different word. Miss one and the next word will not open for you.'
plan:1.cnHint: 师兄在山门外的岩石上展示了他本月采集灵草的____。
plan:1.hook: As he rolled the map up, a dark cloud passed over only the third red circle.
plan:1.line: 'This is my *plan*: one garden each week, no shortcuts, no skipped steps.'

bear:1.en: The ancient spirit tree at the sect's east edge was said to *bear* one silver fruit every hundred years. Master Qingwu brought us to it at midday so we could see the small bud forming at the highest fork. 'A word spoken near this tree becomes permanent,' she said. 'Choose carefully.' None of us spoke for a long time.
bear:1.cnHint: 东侧那棵灵树每百年才____一次银果，师尊带我们前来见证。
bear:1.hook: A second bud appeared on a branch that had been bare all morning.
bear:1.line: 'This tree will *bear* its fruit only for those whose words are true,' Master Qingwu said.

organization:1.en: A messenger arrived at the outer gate before sunrise, wearing the gray sash of a distant mountain *organization* known for trading rare words. He handed Shen Wujiu a sealed letter and left without speaking. I watched from the stone steps as my senior brother read it twice, folded it slowly, and looked up at the horizon with steady eyes.
organization:1.cnHint: 一名来自远山____的信使在清晨抵达山门，递交了一封密封的信件。
organization:1.hook: The seal on the empty envelope began to glow a pale and urgent red.
organization:1.line: 'This *organization* trades in words too rare for any single sect to hold alone,' Shen Wujiu said.

opportunity:1.en: The cloud bridge between our peak and the eastern archive only forms once each season. Xiaoxing grabbed my sleeve at the cliff edge. 'This is our *opportunity* to reach the old word-scrolls,' she said, her voice calm but her grip tight. The bridge was already thinning at the far end, its mist pulling back toward the archive like a slow breath drawn in.
opportunity:1.cnHint: 云桥每季只出现一次，小星说这是我们前往东侧藏经阁的____。
opportunity:1.hook: Something large and slow moved inside the archive's dark upper window.
opportunity:1.line: 'This *opportunity* will not come again for three full months — we move now.'

professor:1.en: The wandering *professor* of word-craft arrived at the sect's outer square just as the afternoon bell rang. He was not young, but he carried no walking stick and cast no shadow in the slanted light. Master Qingwu met him at the gate and bowed once, which none of us had ever seen her do before. Around him the air smelled faintly of rain that had not yet fallen.
professor:1.cnHint: 一位云游的字法____来到了宗门外广场，师尊向他行礼，令弟子们十分惊讶。
professor:1.hook: When he smiled at us, the word carved on the gate stone rearranged itself into a different character.
professor:1.line: 'A *professor* of words remembers every formula he has ever spoken,' he said, meeting our eyes one by one.

sign:1.en: The outer path of the Cloud Sea Sect wound between stone lanterns and carved pillars. Each pillar bore a *sign* — a single word glowing faintly in green light. Shen Wujiu told me that disciples who could read all twelve without blinking had already begun to breathe the mountain's spirit. I counted eleven before my eyes watered.
sign:1.cnHint: 石柱上刻着发光的____，据说能读完全部十二个的弟子已开始感应山灵。
sign:1.hook: The twelfth pillar stood dark, its word completely worn away.
sign:1.line: 'Each *sign* on these pillars is a living word — treat it with respect,' said Shen Wujiu.

feeling:1.en: I stood at the edge of the outer terrace, clouds rolling far below like slow white breath. A strange *feeling* rose in my chest — not fear, not joy, but something older, as if the mountain already knew my name. Xiaoxing stood beside me and said nothing, which somehow made the moment more true.
feeling:1.cnHint: 站在悬崖边，我心中涌起一种奇异的____，仿佛山已知晓我的名字。
feeling:1.hook: Then the clouds parted below, and something vast moved beneath them.
feeling:1.line: 'That *feeling* you have now — hold it close, it will not come twice,' said Xiaoxing softly.

professional:1.en: Master Qingwu reviewed our first word-formulas with calm, steady eyes. Her correction was quiet but exact — the kind of precise attention that only a *professional* master of her art could offer. She changed one stroke in my formula and the pale leaf I was trying to heal turned green within a breath.
professional:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊以____的眼光审阅我们的符文，轻改一笔，枯叶立刻转绿。
professional:1.hook: She paused at Shen Wujiu's formula and did not speak for a long time.
professional:1.line: 'A *professional* hand does not rush — it listens to the word first,' said Master Qingwu.

behind:1.en: We walked in a long line up the stone steps carved into the mountain's side. I fell *behind* the others, stopping to press my hand against the warm rock face where thin blue veins of light pulsed slowly under the surface. The mountain felt alive in a way my village's soil never had.
behind:1.cnHint: 我在队伍中渐渐____，停下来触摸岩壁上缓缓流动的蓝色光脉。
behind:1.hook: When I looked up, every other disciple had vanished into the mist above.
behind:1.line: 'Do not fall *behind* on this path — the steps rearrange themselves after dusk,' warned Shen Wujiu.

government:1.en: Shen Wujiu explained that the Cloud Sea Sect answered to no lord or court. 'We are our own *government*,' he said, gesturing at the circle of elder disciples seated around the Word-Stone. Decisions were made by reading the stone's light, not by any single voice. I wondered what the stone would say about me.
government:1.cnHint: 沈无咎说云海宗自成____，重大决定由问道石的光芒来裁定，而非一人独断。
government:1.hook: As if in reply, the Word-Stone flickered once with a cold blue pulse.
government:1.line: 'The sect is its own *government* — the Word-Stone speaks for all of us,' said Shen Wujiu.

growth:1.en: Master Qingwu showed us a small garden tucked between two peaks, where words had been carved into soil rather than stone. Each carved word fed the plant above it. 'Spiritual *growth* in a disciple works the same way,' she said, 'the right word planted deep enough will change what you become.'
growth:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊带我们参观一处将字刻入土中的花园，说弟子的____与此同理。
growth:1.hook: One plant at the garden's edge had grown far taller than the rest, and its word was unreadable.
growth:1.line: 'True *growth* begins the moment you plant a word you do not yet understand,' said Master Qingwu.

negative:1.en: Xiaoxing warned me about the shadow words — formulas whose meaning runs dark and cold. 'A *negative* word used carelessly can drain the life from a living herb in seconds,' she said, pulling me away from a black-edged inscription on the outer wall. The wall behind it was bare of all moss and light.
negative:1.cnHint: 晓星提醒我，含____含义的字若使用不当，能瞬间吸干草药的生机。
negative:1.hook: I noticed my own shadow had not moved with me when I stepped back.
negative:1.line: 'A *negative* word leaves a mark on the speaker as well as the target,' Xiaoxing said quietly.

potential:1.en: Master Qingwu read my first word-formula slowly, then set it down without a mark. 'The form is rough,' she said, 'but I see *potential* in the root you chose — it reaches toward water and light at the same time.' Shen Wujiu later told me she had said the same thing only twice before in ten years.
potential:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊说我的字根选得有____，因为它同时指向水与光——沈无咎说她十年来只说过两次。
potential:1.hook: That night, my formula began to glow faintly on its own, and I had not touched it.
potential:1.line: 'I see real *potential* in the root you chose — do not waste it,' said Master Qingwu.

save:1.en: The morning mist curled around the herb shelves as Master Qingwu handed me a small jade jar. 'Each word you learn costs the Sect nothing, yet it can *save* a life,' she said. I held the jar carefully, feeling its warmth, and wrote the word three times in the air with two fingers.
save:1.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，每一个学会的词都能____一条生命。
save:1.hook: Then the jar cracked, and a cold wind rose from below.
save:1.line: 'Each word you master may one day *save* someone from the cold dark.'

service:1.en: Shen Wujiu swept the stone path before dawn, each stroke slow and even. He told me that sweeping was a *service* to the mountain itself, that the path thanked those who kept it clean by carrying their steps safely. I picked up a second broom and worked beside him in silence.
service:1.cnHint: 同门师兄说，清扫石径是对这座山的一种____。
service:1.hook: At the path's end, a single black feather lay where none had fallen.
service:1.line: 'Sweeping at dawn is a *service* the mountain remembers, little one.'

note:1.en: Xiaoxing pressed a folded leaf into my hand and whispered, 'Read this before the trial.' Inside, a single *note* in her small handwriting listed the five healing words in order, with a tiny drawing of a cloud beside each one. I tucked it into my sleeve and felt less alone.
note:1.cnHint: 同门师妹悄悄给了我一张____，上面写着五个治愈词的顺序。
note:1.hook: When I opened my sleeve again, the leaf had turned silver.
note:1.line: 'I left you a *note* with the five words — do not lose it.'

probably:1.en: The trial hall doors were carved from a single pale stone. Shen Wujiu stood beside me and said, 'You will *probably* feel the words rise in your chest before they reach your tongue.' I nodded, though I had never felt anything rise in my chest before, and wondered if I ever would.
probably:1.cnHint: 同门师兄说，我____会在开口前感受到词语在胸口升起。
probably:1.hook: A low hum began inside the stone doors, growing louder by the breath.
probably:1.line: 'You will *probably* hear the mountain answer before you finish speaking.'

strategy:1.en: Master Qingwu drew a circle in the air and said our *strategy* for the cloud-passage test was simple: speak the anchor word first, then the lift word, never the other way around. I repeated the order until it sat like a stone in my memory. Outside, the clouds shifted and thinned.
strategy:1.cnHint: 师尊说，通过云道考验的____很简单：先说锚定词，再说提升词。
strategy:1.hook: A gap opened in the clouds below, darker than any I had seen before.
strategy:1.line: 'Our *strategy* is to anchor first — speak the lift word too soon and you fall.'

building:1.en: At the peak of the third mountain stood the oldest *building* of the Sect, its roof tiles green with moss and its doorframe carved with ten thousand words too small to read from below. I climbed the last steps alone, heart quick, and pressed one palm flat against the cold door.
building:1.cnHint: 山顶那座最古老的____门框上刻满了小得无法辨认的词语。
building:1.hook: The door breathed out a warm sigh, though no one was inside.
building:1.line: 'Every stone of this *building* holds a word the first disciples ever spoke.'

community:1.en: Master Qingwu gathered all the new disciples on the open terrace and said that the Cloud Sea Sect was not a school but a *community*, meaning that every word one of us mastered belonged to all of us. Xiaoxing reached over and took my hand briefly, then let go, both of us looking at the clouds.
community:1.cnHint: 师尊说，云海宗不是学堂，而是一个____，每个人学会的词都属于所有人。
community:1.hook: Below the terrace, a shape moved through the cloud sea that had no name yet.
community:1.line: 'We are a *community* here — your words strengthen every disciple around you.'

internet:1.en: A travelling merchant stopped at the gate, carrying a glowing scroll he called a record of all known words. Shen Wujiu shook his head slowly: 'Our masters once dreamed of something like an *internet* of living words, flowing free between every peak.' The merchant bowed and moved on into the mist.
internet:1.cnHint: 同门师兄说，古时的师尊们曾梦想建立一个词语自由流通的____。
internet:1.hook: The merchant's lantern winked out before he reached the first bridge.
internet:1.line: 'They called it an *internet* of words — knowledge moving like wind between mountains.'

perhaps:1.en: The stone steps of the outer court were swept clean each morning, and I swept them too, learning that silence was its own kind of lesson. Shen Wujiu watched me from the arch above. '*Perhaps* you already carry the word you need,' he said, his breath making a small cloud in the cold air. I looked at my broom and wondered what he meant.
perhaps:1.cnHint: 师兄看着我打扫台阶，说我____已经拥有所需的词语。
perhaps:1.hook: That night, a single character glowed on the broom handle.
perhaps:1.line: '*Perhaps* the answer is already in your hands, junior.'

video:1.en: Master Qingwu kept a jade mirror in the teaching hall. When she pressed her palm to it, a moving image appeared — a *video* of past disciples reciting the Breath Formula, their voices rising like smoke. 'Watch how their lips form the word,' she said. I leaned closer, and the mirror grew warm against my face.
video:1.cnHint: 师尊用玉镜播放了一段*___*，展示前辈弟子如何念诵吐息诀。
video:1.hook: At the final frame, one disciple's face turned and looked straight at me.
video:1.line: 'This *video* holds the voices of those who walked this path before you.'

prevent:1.en: A cold wind rolled up from the sea of clouds below, carrying a sound like distant bells. Xiaoxing grabbed my sleeve. 'Step back,' she said. 'The wind carries a hollow word — it will *prevent* any formula you speak from taking root.' I closed my mouth. The bells grew louder, then stopped.
prevent:1.cnHint: 师妹警告我，那阵风会____我的法诀生根，让我退后。
prevent:1.hook: In the silence that followed, something beneath the clouds rose an inch higher.
prevent:1.line: 'That wind will *prevent* your words from reaching the sky — stay still.'

source:1.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the edge of the outer platform, where a thin stream of light rose from the clouds below. 'Every word in our sect has a *source*,' he said, pointing down. 'Ours begins in the water that never touches the ground.' I reached out one hand, and a single drop landed on my palm and did not fall.
source:1.cnHint: 师兄带我看云海中升起的光流，解释每个词语都有其____。
source:1.hook: The drop on my palm slowly spelled out a character I had never seen.
source:1.line: 'Trace a word back to its *source* and you will know its true power.'

available:1.en: The sect herb garden floated on a smaller stone shelf to the east. Not every plant was open to new disciples. 'Only three kinds are *available* to you at this stage,' Master Qingwu said, walking the narrow row. 'Take more and the garden will remember.' I chose the smallest leaf, and the soil around it hummed once.
available:1.cnHint: 师尊说药园中只有三种草药对我____，多取则园子会记住。
available:1.hook: Behind the third pot, a fourth plant had already bloomed overnight.
available:1.line: 'Only these three herbs are *available* to a first-season disciple like you.'

customer:1.en: Once a month a trading boat rose through the clouds and docked at the lower gate. Merchants sold ink stones, brush handles, and sealed jars of voice-dew. Xiaoxing whispered to me, 'Every *customer* here is buying a word they could not grow themselves.' I watched an old man tuck a small jar inside his robe and descend alone.
customer:1.cnHint: 师妹说来此买词的每位____都是买不到自己无法修炼的词语。
customer:1.hook: The old man's shadow on the dock spelled a warning no one else noticed.
customer:1.line: 'Each *customer* at this gate carries a longing that ink alone cannot fill.'

language:1.en: Master Qingwu set a plain stone on the table between us. 'Before you learn any formula,' she said, 'you must understand that every *language* of cultivation is also a living thing — it breathes, it ages, it forgets.' She tapped the stone once, and a hairline crack appeared along its centre. I felt the air in the room change.
language:1.cnHint: 师尊说每一种修炼的____都是活物，会呼吸、衰老，也会遗忘。
language:1.hook: The crack in the stone slowly widened into the shape of an open mouth.
language:1.line: 'The *language* of this sect is older than the mountains you are standing on.'

test:1.en: Shen Wujiu set two jars on the low wall at the edge of the platform — one filled with morning dew, one with cloud-water from below. 'This is a *test* of the word Clarity,' he said, folding his arms. 'Speak it once. The right jar will glow.' I breathed in, shaped the word, and spoke. One jar glowed. The other cracked cleanly in two.
test:1.cnHint: 师兄用两个罐子来____我能否念出"清明"这个词，让正确的那个发光。
test:1.hook: Inside the cracked jar, a second word floated up, unasked for.
test:1.line: 'Consider this a *test* — the mountain itself will mark whether you pass.'

force:1.en: The wind path between the peaks was narrow. Master Qingwu told us not to *force* our way through by shouting the word 'open' — the mountain would resist any disciple whose breath held fear. I steadied myself and spoke it softly instead. The mist parted like a curtain. Above the clouds, a single black feather drifted upward.
force:1.cnHint: 师尊警告我们不要用____穿越山间风道，否则山体会反弹。
force:1.hook: That feather came from no bird any of us recognized.
force:1.line: 'Do not *force* the word — let the mountain hear your calm.'

importance:1.en: Shen Wujiu swept the stone steps of the outer courtyard each morning without complaint. I once asked why. He said the *importance* of small duties was itself a lesson, older than any formula in the sect's library. I copied his motion and felt something stir in my palm. A warm glow rose from the flagstones and was gone.
importance:1.cnHint: 师兄解释了日常小事的____，扫地时我掌心忽然感应到了什么。
importance:1.hook: No one had told me the courtyard stones could answer to touch.
importance:1.line: 'The *importance* of small acts — that is the first formula.'

sell:1.en: At the cloud-market ledge, merchants traded words pressed into thin jade slips. One old woman tried to *sell* Xiaoxing a slip marked 'swift,' but Xiaoxing held it to the light and shook her head — the character inside was hollow, its spirit already spent. The woman smiled too quickly and turned away. A cold wind rose from below the clouds for no reason.
sell:1.cnHint: 在云市，一位老妇人想____给小星一枚灵字玉片，但小星发现它已失效。
sell:1.hook: The woman's shadow moved one step before she did.
sell:1.line: 'She tried to *sell* me a word with nothing left inside.'

replace:1.en: Master Qingwu set a cracked jade slip on the teaching stone and asked which of us could *replace* it with a newly inscribed one without losing the original meaning. I pressed my fingertip to the crack and breathed the word 'restore.' The slip sealed itself. Master Qingwu said nothing but walked away, which meant I had done it correctly. That evening, the stars above the main peak arranged into a shape none of the older disciples could name.
replace:1.cnHint: 师尊要求我们用新的玉片____旧的破裂玉片，我尝试后成功了。
replace:1.hook: The nameless star-shape pulsed once, then held perfectly still.
replace:1.line: 'Can anyone *replace* this slip and keep its spirit whole?'

approach:1.en: The bridge to the inner hall was long and silent. Shen Wujiu had told me that the right *approach* was to recite the word 'patient' with every third step — not to hurry, not to pause. I counted carefully. The bridge accepted me without a tremor. Behind me I heard a second set of footsteps that had not been there before.
approach:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我进入内殿的正确____是每走三步默念一个字。
approach:1.hook: The second footsteps matched mine exactly, then stopped.
approach:1.line: 'Your *approach* to the bridge determines what the bridge becomes.'

engage:1.en: During the morning lesson on the outer terrace, Master Qingwu asked us to *engage* with the word 'listen' by holding it on the tongue without speaking it aloud. Xiaoxing lasted the longest — her eyes went wide halfway through, as though she had heard something far below the clouds. She would not say what it was. A low hum rose from the valley and faded before anyone could point toward its source.
engage:1.cnHint: 师尊让我们在晨课中用心____'listen'这个字，小星坚持得最久，听到了某种声音。
engage:1.hook: The hum had the rhythm of a word no one in the sect had taught us.
engage:1.line: '*Engage* with the word fully — half a heart will not do.'

ensure:1.en: Before any disciple could enter the cloud library, Shen Wujiu checked each person's breathing stone to *ensure* the character carved on it still held its light. Mine flickered twice when he held it up. He pressed his thumb to it and whispered, and the light steadied. He handed it back without comment. That night my dreams were filled with a corridor I had never walked.
ensure:1.cnHint: 师兄检查每人的呼吸石，____其上的字仍有灵光，我的石头曾两次闪烁。
ensure:1.hook: The corridor in my dream ended at a door carved with my own name.
ensure:1.line: 'I check each stone to *ensure* the word inside is still alive.'

limit:1.en: The elder at the gate set a *limit* of three spoken words per crossing — more than three and the bridge would judge the speaker greedy and thin the mist beneath their feet. I chose 'calm,' 'clear,' and 'home.' Each step held firm. Across the bridge, Xiaoxing was waiting with a strange expression. She pointed at the clouds below us, where something large moved slowly just beneath the surface.
limit:1.cnHint: 关口长老规定过桥时说话有____，最多只能说三个字，否则会有危险。
limit:1.hook: Whatever moved below the clouds was the size of a mountain hall.
limit:1.line: 'Know your *limit* — the bridge counts every word you speak.'

exist:1.en: High on the outer terrace, I stared down at the sea of clouds below. Master Qingwu had told us that certain herbs could only *exist* where sky and mist touched the stone together. I pressed my hand against the cold wall and began to believe her words at last.
exist:1.cnHint: 师尊说过，某些草药只____于云雾与山石相接之处，我终于信了。
exist:1.hook: Beneath my palm, the wall trembled once, then was still.
exist:1.line: 'These herbs *exist* only where the sky feeds the stone,' said Master Qingwu.

supply:1.en: Xiaoxing hurried across the courtyard with a basket almost too heavy to lift. The sect's *supply* of dried wind-root had run low after three weeks of rain, and every senior disciple had been asked to gather more before dusk. A faint bell rang from somewhere deep in the mountain.
supply:1.cnHint: 连续阴雨之后，宗门的风根草____告急，师妹赶着在日落前收集更多。
supply:1.hook: The bell rang again, though no one stood near the tower.
supply:1.line: 'Our *supply* of wind-root will not last the week,' said Xiaoxing.

visit:1.en: It was rare for a disciple from another sect to come to Cloud Sea. The *visit* lasted only one afternoon, yet the young stranger walked every terrace and studied each herb garden with quiet, careful eyes. Master Qingwu watched from the high arch and said nothing at all.
visit:1.cnHint: 一位外宗弟子前来____，只待了一个下午，却将每座草药园都仔细看了一遍。
visit:1.hook: Before he left, the stranger paused and wrote one word in the dust.
visit:1.line: 'This *visit* tells us more about them than they intend,' said Master Qingwu.

worry:1.en: I carried the morning's herb list to the outer garden, but two plants on it were missing. A small *worry* settled in my chest as I counted the empty patches a second time. Shen Wujiu found me there and read the list over my shoulder without a word.
worry:1.cnHint: 晨间草药清单上有两株不见了，我心生____，数了第二遍仍是如此。
worry:1.hook: Shen Wujiu's face, when he finished reading, was carefully blank.
worry:1.line: 'Your *worry* is reasonable — someone was here before dawn,' said Shen Wujiu.

adapt:1.en: The terrace gardens changed with every season, and new disciples had to *adapt* quickly or lose whole batches of herbs. I spent the first cool morning replanting the frost-shy roots closer to the warm eastern stones. Xiaoxing watched me work and clapped softly when the last root settled in.
adapt:1.cnHint: 新弟子必须迅速____季节变化，我把怕霜的草根移到向阳的东侧石边。
adapt:1.hook: Xiaoxing's smile faded as clouds rolled over the eastern peak.
adapt:1.line: 'You must *adapt* your planting before the frost comes tonight,' said Xiaoxing.

bit:1.en: Master Qingwu handed me a formula carved on a thin strip of bark. I read it once, then again, understanding only a *bit* of its meaning — enough to know it described something powerful, not enough to know whether it was a cure or a warning. The bark felt warm.
bit:1.cnHint: 师尊递给我一张树皮符文，我只读懂了其中的一____，却已感到它非同寻常。
bit:1.hook: The bark grew warmer the longer I held it.
bit:1.line: 'Even a small *bit* of this formula can change a cloud's path,' said Master Qingwu.

check:1.en: Before the outer gate was sealed for the night, Shen Wujiu walked the full length of the herb terrace to *check* that every marker stone stood in its place. I followed a few steps behind, noting the ones that had shifted since morning. The last stone was missing entirely.
check:1.cnHint: 夜间封门前，师兄沿草药台阶逐一____标记石，最后一块却不见了。
check:1.hook: Where the last stone had stood, the earth was freshly turned.
check:1.line: '*Check* each marker before you leave — order here is not decoration,' said Shen Wujiu.

easily:1.en: The stone steps of Cloud Sea Sect wound upward through pale mist. I had expected the climb to leave me breathless, but Shen Wujiu moved so *easily* that his white robe barely shifted. He paused, turned, and offered his hand with a quiet smile. Above us, the peak was already glowing.
easily:1.cnHint: 师兄在云雾中____地攀上石阶，令我惊叹不已。
easily:1.hook: But the glow was not sunlight — something had awakened above.
easily:1.line: 'A true disciple *easily* reads the mountain's breath before their first step.'

protect:1.en: Master Qingwu drew a slow circle in the air with her brush. A faint ring of pale light settled around the courtyard gate. 'Words spoken with true intent can *protect* what force alone cannot hold,' she said. The other disciples bowed. I pressed the phrase into memory like a seed into soil.
protect:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊用一句话语____了整个山门，弟子们静静聆听。
protect:1.hook: Then the gate lantern flickered, and no wind was blowing.
protect:1.line: 'Learn this word well — it may *protect* you when the cloud breaks.'

advantage:1.en: Shen Wujiu laid three spirit-herb scrolls on the flat rock between us. 'Knowing the name of a herb before you need it is your greatest *advantage*,' he said. I copied each character with care. Far below, the sea of clouds shifted, swallowing a distant peak whole.
advantage:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，提前掌握草药名称是修炼时最大的____。
advantage:1.hook: The swallowed peak had held the oldest word-garden in the sect.
advantage:1.line: 'Name a thing rightly, and its name becomes your *advantage*.'

break:1.en: The morning gong sounded, and Master Qingwu called it a *break* in the day's recitation. Disciples scattered across the stone terrace, whispering half-learned formulas to the open air. Xiaoxing found me at the edge, watching a hawk ride a thermal upward through the mist.
break:1.cnHint: 师尊宣布一天诵读中途____，弟子们在露台上小歇片刻。
break:1.hook: The hawk carried something silver in its talons, and it was flying toward our peak.
break:1.line: 'Use every *break* wisely — the mountain does not rest between lessons.'

conclude:1.en: After three rounds of recitation, Master Qingwu folded her hands and let silence hold the hall for a long moment. 'We *conclude* today's lesson with a question, not an answer,' she said softly. She wrote one unknown word on the board and left it there, unanswered, as the candles dimmed.
conclude:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊以一个问题____了今天的课程，答案留给弟子自己寻找。
conclude:1.hook: The unknown word on the board began, very slowly, to glow.
conclude:1.line: 'When you can *conclude* the meaning from context alone, you are ready.'

figure:1.en: Xiaoxing pointed to the carved stone at the sect entrance. A tall *figure* was cut into it — neither clearly man nor spirit, arms raised toward the clouds, mouth open as if speaking. 'That is the First Disciple,' she said. 'Every word we study was found by them, one by one.'
figure:1.cnHint: 小星指着门口石碑上的____，讲述了第一位弟子寻找字语的故事。
figure:1.hook: I noticed the carved mouth had been worn smooth — as if many hands had touched it in silence.
figure:1.line: 'Study that *figure* well — its posture is itself the first formula.'

fit:1.en: Master Qingwu handed me a small jade tablet etched with a beginner's formula. I turned it over and tried to *fit* the words to the feeling rising in my chest — something warm, something half-remembered. The tablet hummed once, faintly, and then went still in my palm.
fit:1.cnHint: 我试着将玉牌上的字语____心中那股隐约的感应，玉牌随之轻鸣。
fit:1.hook: A second hum answered from somewhere deep beneath the floating mountain.
fit:1.line: 'Find the word that will *fit* the feeling — that is the whole art.'

particular:1.en: Shen Wujiu stopped me at the herb-terrace gate and pointed to one *particular* plant among dozens — its leaves pale silver, its stem no thicker than a brush handle. 'That one has a name that can calm a storm,' he said quietly. 'Learn it before the season turns.'
particular:1.cnHint: 师兄在草药台前指出一株____的植物，说它的名字能平息风暴。
particular:1.hook: Behind us, the wind shifted, and the season, it seemed, was already turning.
particular:1.line: 'This *particular* word is rare — do not waste it on a small wind.'

stick:1.en: The stone path wound to the edge of the floating mountain, where morning mist hung like a held breath. Master Qingwu pressed a word-herb against the cracked rock, and I watched it *stick* firmly to the surface, its green light seeping inward like ink into cloth. 'Hold it there,' she said. 'The mountain must accept it.' Far below, the sea of clouds churned.
stick:1.cnHint: 师尊将一株字草____在山壁上，命我观察它如何将灵力渗入石缝。
stick:1.hook: Beneath our feet, the mountain gave a single, deep groan.
stick:1.line: 'Let the word *stick* to the stone before you speak the next syllable.'

effective:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small scroll at the outer gate, where wind swept loose petals from the sky-plum trees. 'This formula is the most *effective* one for sealing cracks in the mountain path,' he said, his voice calm and sure. I read it twice, feeling its syllables settle in my chest like warm stones. The gate lantern flickered once and went still.
effective:1.cnHint: 师兄在山门处告诉我，这道封路咒文是最____的一种。
effective:1.hook: Then a second crack split the path, wider than the first.
effective:1.line: 'The seal is only *effective* if you speak it before the third bell.'

fear:1.en: At the outer terrace, clouds rolled in fast, swallowing the lower peaks whole. Xiaoxing stood beside me, her robe pressed flat by the wind. I felt a sharp *fear* rise in my throat — not of falling, but of the silence the clouds carried with them, as though every word in the world had been erased. She took one quiet breath and wrote a single character in the air.
fear:1.cnHint: 站在外台上，我心中升起一阵____，不是因为高处，而是因为云雾中奇异的寂静。
fear:1.hook: The character she wrote began, slowly, to bleed light.
fear:1.line: '*Fear* is just a word that has not yet found its formula.'

hit:1.en: We practiced breath-casting on the wide stone terrace below the first arch. I released my word three times; the first two faded like smoke. The third time, the syllable *hit* the target stone square at its centre, and a ring of pale blue light spread outward across the ground. Shen Wujiu nodded once. Somewhere above, a bell rang that no one had touched.
hit:1.cnHint: 练习时，我第三次出声，字力终于精准地____到了靶心石上。
hit:1.hook: The bell rang again — and there was no bell tower on this peak.
hit:1.line: 'Let the word build until it can *hit* the stone without force.'

assume:1.en: Master Qingwu met us on the herb path where luminous roots crossed the stone like sleeping veins. 'Do not *assume* a word has only one meaning,' she said, turning a silver-leafed herb in her fingers. 'This one heals. It also locks. The mountain taught it both, and the mountain does not forget.' I looked at the herb and felt the ground tilt, very slightly, beneath me.
assume:1.cnHint: 师尊告诫我们，不要____一个字只有一种含义，因为每株字草都身兼数用。
assume:1.hook: The silver leaf curled shut, as if it had heard her.
assume:1.line: 'Never *assume* a healing word cannot also become a seal.'

generally:1.en: Xiaoxing walked me through the seed garden on the eastern ledge, where rows of unspoken words lay dormant in dark soil. '*Generally* the blue-stem words wake first,' she said, crouching to brush one with her finger. 'But this season something is wrong — none of them have opened.' She stood, and her shadow fell long across the silent rows. The clouds below us rose a little higher.
generally:1.cnHint: 师妹解释说，蓝茎字草____最先萌发，但这一季它们都还没有开口。
generally:1.hook: One black stem, at the far end, began to glow faint red.
generally:1.line: '*Generally* you would hear them humming by the third dawn.'

interaction:1.en: On the bridge between the second and third peaks, Master Qingwu set two word-stones side by side and stepped back. 'Watch the *interaction*,' she said. The two stones pulsed in turn, their light weaving together until a third shape rose between them — something none of us had seen named before. She wrote it down without speaking. The bridge swayed once in still air.
interaction:1.cnHint: 师尊让两块字石相邻放置，让我们观察它们之间的____，结果生出了一个无名新字。
interaction:1.hook: The new shape drifted upward and vanished into the clouds.
interaction:1.line: 'The *interaction* of two words can birth a third that neither word knows.'

top:1.en: I climbed to the *top* of the gate pillar at dawn to hang the new word-banner, as Shen Wujiu had shown me. From there the whole Cloud Sea spread below, white and still as a held thought. I tied the last knot and looked down — and saw, carved into the pillar just beneath my feet, a word I did not recognize, older than anything in the sect's library.
top:1.cnHint: 我爬到山门石柱的____，悬挂新字幡，却在脚下发现了一个图书馆里从未收录的古字。
top:1.hook: The ancient word began to vibrate, faint and steady, against my palms.
top:1.line: 'At the *top* of every pillar there is a word the sect has not yet read.'

fruit:1.en: The outer terrace of Cloud Sea Sect smelled of morning dew and old bark. Master Qingwu held up a small, glowing orb and said it was the *fruit* of ten years spent learning the Word of Renewal — one seed of meaning, grown patient and full. I cupped it in both hands and felt warmth spread to my wrists.
fruit:1.cnHint: 师尊将十年修炼所结的____展示给我看，那是一颗散发温热的光球。
fruit:1.hook: Then the orb pulsed once, and the light turned the colour of a warning.
fruit:1.line: 'This *fruit* took me ten years — do not let it fall,' said Master Qingwu.

waste:1.en: On the stone path between the herb terraces, Shen Wujiu watched me recite the same word twenty times without feeling. He shook his head slowly. 'You *waste* breath on sound alone,' he said. 'A word spoken without intent is just wind.' Around us, the floating mountain shivered, and loose petals fell into the clouds below.
waste:1.cnHint: 师兄告诫我，不带意念地诵读只是在____精气与时间。
waste:1.hook: A petal caught fire before it reached the cloud line.
waste:1.line: 'Do not *waste* your breath — pour your will into every word,' said Shen Wujiu.

learning:1.en: Xiaoxing spread her notes across the wide flat rock near the eastern edge, where the wind was calm. She said that *learning* at Cloud Sea Sect was not the same as memorising words — it was listening until the word listened back. I sat beside her and tried to hear the silence between the syllables.
learning:1.cnHint: 师妹向我解释，在云海宗的____不是死记硬背，而是用心倾听。
learning:1.hook: From somewhere below the clouds, a low hum rose and grew louder.
learning:1.line: 'True *learning* begins when the word starts to answer you,' said Xiaoxing.

manager:1.en: At the supply terrace near the sect gate, an older disciple moved between rows of sealed jars with quiet authority. Shen Wujiu told me that disciple was the *manager* of all stored Words — every sealed syllable passed through their hands before reaching a student. I bowed, and the disciple gave me one jar without a label.
manager:1.cnHint: 师兄介绍说，那位弟子是所有封存语词的____，负责分发给学生。
manager:1.hook: The unlabelled jar hummed faintly against my palm.
manager:1.line: 'As *manager* of the Word stores, I give only what a student is ready for,' the disciple said.

knowledge:1.en: The morning lesson was held on the open platform above the cloud line, where the sky pressed close. Master Qingwu said that *knowledge* of a word was not the same as power over it — understanding where a word came from gave it roots, and roots gave it force. I wrote that down before the wind could take the thought.
knowledge:1.cnHint: 师尊说，对语词的____不等于掌控它，还需追溯其来源以扎根。
knowledge:1.hook: As she finished speaking, the cloud line below us cracked like ice.
knowledge:1.line: '*Knowledge* without roots is a flame with no wood to feed it,' said Master Qingwu.

mental:1.en: Between lessons, Xiaoxing showed me the narrow bridge of rope and plank that crossed two peaks. She said the crossing was a *mental* trial more than a physical one — the bridge was steady, but doubt made it sway. I set one foot on the first plank and felt my thoughts scatter like startled birds.
mental:1.cnHint: 师妹说，过那座吊桥是一种____考验，动摇的是心念而非桥本身。
mental:1.hook: Halfway across, the plank beneath my foot went perfectly, terrifyingly still.
mental:1.line: 'The real danger on that bridge is *mental* — steady your mind first,' said Xiaoxing.

weight:1.en: Near the gatehouse, a row of smooth stones sat on a low shelf, each one carved with a single word. Shen Wujiu told me to pick up the stone marked with the Word of Burden. The moment I touched it, I felt a *weight* far beyond stone — something pressing from the inside out, like a held breath looking for a way free.
weight:1.cnHint: 师兄让我拿起刻有"重负"二字的石头，我感到一种超乎想象的____。
weight:1.hook: I set it down, and the shelf cracked clean in two.
weight:1.line: 'Feel the *weight* — that is what an unspoken word carries over years,' said Shen Wujiu.

academic:1.en: At the archive hall built into the cliff face, rows of scrolls glowed faintly in the dim light. Xiaoxing said the older scrolls held *academic* records of every word ever mastered at Cloud Sea Sect — names, dates, and the exact moment each disciple first made a word respond. She ran one finger along a shelf and stopped without saying why.
academic:1.cnHint: 师妹介绍说，崖壁档案堂里存放着宗门的____记录，记载着每个弟子的修炼节点。
academic:1.hook: Her finger rested on a scroll with no name on its cover.
academic:1.line: 'The *academic* records never lie — your first response will be written here,' said Xiaoxing.

consequence:1.en: The stone path outside the Sect gate was silent at dawn. I had skipped my morning recitation, thinking no one would notice. But Master Qingwu stood at the gate, eyes calm as still water. 'Every skipped word has a *consequence*,' she said. 'The cloud you cannot name will carry you nowhere.' A cold wind rose from below the mountain.
consequence:1.cnHint: 我逃掉了晨课，却在山门口遇见了师尊，她说每一个被忽略的词语都有____。
consequence:1.hook: Below the gate, the clouds parted — revealing nothing but darkness.
consequence:1.line: 'Every skipped word has a *consequence*,' Master Qingwu said softly.

realize:1.en: I stood at the outer terrace, watching cloud-mist curl around the lower peaks. Shen Wujiu handed me a small herb — a word-leaf of healing. Only when it dissolved on my tongue did I *realize* how dry and tired my voice had grown from days of silent study. The herb tasted of rain and something older. Far below, a bell rang once and stopped.
realize:1.cnHint: 直到药草在舌尖化开，我才____自己的声音已因长期沉默而变得多么疲惫。
realize:1.hook: The bell rang once — and the clouds below began to glow.
realize:1.line: 'You will *realize* its value only when your voice fails you,' Shen Wujiu said.

mostly:1.en: The outer courtyard was *mostly* quiet before the morning bell, except for Xiaoxing, who practiced her word-steps at the edge of the stone platform each day. I watched her feet trace the syllables of a wind formula across the cold ground. She never fell. I tried once and nearly stepped off the cloud-ledge. A feather drifted up from the white sea below.
mostly:1.cnHint: 外院清晨____是安静的，只有师妹一人在石台边练习踏字步。
mostly:1.hook: The feather hung still in the air — as if the wind itself was listening.
mostly:1.line: 'It is *mostly* patience, not talent, that keeps you from falling,' Xiaoxing said.

exactly:1.en: Master Qingwu drew a single word in the air above the outer path. The light-stroke hung there, trembling. 'Place your breath *exactly* here,' she said, pressing one finger to a point inside the glowing character. I tried. The word flared gold for one heartbeat, then faded. Shen Wujiu said nothing, but his eyes were wide. Smoke rose from where the word had been.
exactly:1.cnHint: 师尊要我把呼吸____地落在那个悬空字符的某一点上。
exactly:1.hook: Where the word had burned, a small crack split the stone path.
exactly:1.line: 'Place your breath *exactly* here, and not one breath-width away,' said Master Qingwu.

vary:1.en: Outside the herb-word garden on the east terrace, the air itself seemed to breathe. Xiaoxing showed me how the color of a word-leaf could *vary* with the hour — pale silver at dawn, deep green at noon, faintly gold at dusk. 'The meaning shifts with the light,' she said. I reached out to touch a dusk-gold leaf. My fingers came away warm.
vary:1.cnHint: 师妹向我展示了词草的颜色如何随时辰____，清晨、正午、黄昏各不相同。
vary:1.hook: The gold leaf curled shut the moment a cloud passed over the sun.
vary:1.line: 'The power they carry will *vary*, so choose your hour with care,' Xiaoxing said.

brain:1.en: Shen Wujiu sat beside me on the outer steps, watching me struggle with a memory formula. 'A cultivator's *brain* is like a deep well,' he said. 'Pour too many words in at once and they spill.' He tapped the side of his head gently. I closed my scroll. Above us, two birds flew in slow circles, casting moving shadows across the stone.
brain:1.cnHint: 师兄坐在台阶旁告诉我，修行者的____就像一口深井，一次灌入太多词语只会溢出来。
brain:1.hook: The birds' shadows merged into one — and then vanished entirely.
brain:1.line: 'A cultivator's *brain* needs rest as much as it needs study,' Shen Wujiu said.

stress:1.en: The assessment path wound along the outer cliff edge. Each disc of stone bore a word, and I had to speak them in the right rhythm. Master Qingwu watched from a distance. The *stress* of the test pressed down like a low cloud. I spoke the first word cleanly. The stone lit up. My heart settled, just slightly. Then the last stone began to shake.
stress:1.cnHint: 在悬崖外侧的测试路上，考核的____压得像低垂的云，我深吸一口气说出了第一个词。
stress:1.hook: The last stone shook once, then rose slowly into the air.
stress:1.line: 'Let the *stress* sharpen you — do not let it silence you,' said Master Qingwu.

financial:1.en: A traveling merchant had climbed to the Sect's outer gate, offering rare word-scrolls for sale. Shen Wujiu studied the price list and shook his head. 'My *financial* situation allows for one scroll only,' he said with a small smile. He chose the simplest one — a single healing word. That night, he used it to mend a cracked step near my room. A light lingered there until dawn.
financial:1.cnHint: 师兄看了看价格单，说自己的____状况只允许他买一卷词简。
financial:1.hook: The light on the mended step was still glowing when the morning bell rang.
financial:1.line: 'My *financial* situation is modest, but one good word is enough,' said Shen Wujiu.

trouble:1.en: The morning market on the outer bridge was loud with traders offering rare word-stones. I had only three copper coins left. Shen Wujiu pulled me aside: 'Do not touch the red ones.' A vendor noticed us hesitating and raised his voice. That small moment of *trouble* drew every eye on the bridge to us — including a pair that did not belong to any trader.
trouble:1.cnHint: 我在集市上陷入____，引来了不该注意我们的目光。
trouble:1.hook: The watcher's robe bore no sect mark at all.
trouble:1.line: 'A little *trouble* now is better than a great wound later,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

reflect:1.en: At the still pool beside the gate, new disciples were told to speak one word and watch how the water moved. I chose the word for 'sky.' The surface did not *reflect* my face — it showed a mountain above the one we were standing on, hidden in clouds no eye could reach from here. Xiaoxing gripped my sleeve without a word.
reflect:1.cnHint: 水面没有____出我的脸，而是映出了一座隐藏的山。
reflect:1.hook: The hidden mountain had a light burning in its peak.
reflect:1.line: 'What a pool can *reflect* is not always what you expect to see,' Xiaoxing whispered.

attend:1.en: Every new disciple was required to *attend* the Dawn Word Assembly on the outer terrace, where Master Qingwu would speak the first formula of the season aloud. I arrived just as the clouds below the mountain began to glow orange. The word Master Qingwu chose this year was not one listed in any text I had read. A cold wind rose the moment she finished speaking it.
attend:1.cnHint: 我们必须____清晨的词语仪式，师尊念出了一个从未见过的字。
attend:1.hook: The cold wind carried a smell of rain and old iron.
attend:1.line: 'All disciples must *attend* — the word spoken today will follow you for a year,' Master Qingwu said.

belief:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small stone carved with a single character. 'This was given to me on my first day,' he said. 'I have carried it ever since.' He told me that every step on a floating mountain begins not with strength but with *belief* — that the stone beneath your foot is real, that the word in your mouth has weight. Far below, a section of cloud thinned and showed only open sky.
belief:1.cnHint: 师兄说，踏上浮山的第一步靠的是____，而非力气。
belief:1.hook: Through that gap in the cloud, something dark was rising.
belief:1.line: 'Without *belief* in the word, even the strongest formula is empty air,' Shen Wujiu said.

carry:1.en: Each first-year disciple was given a small cloth bundle at the gate — inside were three dried word-leaves, one vial of cloud water, and a folded map of the outer paths. Master Qingwu said we were allowed to *carry* only what fit in that single bundle for the first month. I tied mine carefully and noticed that Xiaoxing's bundle was already giving off a faint silver light. She had not opened it yet.
carry:1.cnHint: 每位新弟子只能____一个小包裹，而师妹的包裹已经发出银光。
carry:1.hook: No one else seemed to notice the light but me.
carry:1.line: '*Carry* only what is yours — borrowed power always finds its way back,' Master Qingwu said.

else:1.en: After the assembly I lingered near the carved stone pillars at the terrace edge. The other disciples had all gone inside. I felt sure I had missed something — a gesture, a sound, a meaning — something *else* beneath the surface of the ceremony that the rest seemed to understand without being told. A single white feather drifted up from the clouds below and landed at my feet, pointing inward toward the hall.
else:1.cnHint: 我觉得仪式之下还有____的含义，一根白羽从云中飘来落在脚边。
else:1.hook: The feather was warm, as if it had just been shed.
else:1.line: 'If something feels like it means *else* beyond its words, trust that feeling,' Xiaoxing said later.

prepare:1.en: The morning bell had not yet rung when Shen Wujiu shook my shoulder. 'The herb-naming trial begins at dawn,' he said. 'We must *prepare* our word-scrolls tonight.' I rolled the thin paper carefully, pressing each character into memory. Outside, the clouds below the mountain began to glow a faint, uneasy red.
prepare:1.cnHint: 天亮前，师兄提醒我要为草药命名考验____好一切。
prepare:1.hook: The red glow deepened, and something beneath the clouds began to rise.
prepare:1.line: 'We must *prepare* our word-scrolls before the trial bell rings.'

workplace:1.en: Master Qingwu led us to the Herb Terrace, a wide stone platform hanging over the sea of clouds. 'This terrace is your *workplace* now,' she said quietly. 'Every word you learn here is a tool. Lose it, and you lose a piece of your strength.' I touched the cold stone railing and felt how far down the clouds truly were.
workplace:1.cnHint: 师尊将我们带到草药台，告诉我们这里就是我们的____。
workplace:1.hook: A crack, thin as a hair, split the stone beneath my hand.
workplace:1.line: 'This terrace is your *workplace* — treat every word learned here with care.'

post:1.en: Xiaoxing pointed to the great wooden board at the sect gate. Someone had used a brush made from a storm-cloud feather to *post* a new list of forbidden word-formulas overnight. The ink still smelled of lightning. Disciples crowded close, whispering. I counted seven words I had already memorised, and a cold feeling settled in my chest.
post:1.cnHint: 小星发现有人在宗门门口____了一张新的禁用咒语名单。
post:1.hook: The seventh word on the list was the one Master Qingwu had taught only me.
post:1.line: 'Who dared to *post* forbidden formulas on the sect gate at night?'

complete:1.en: I had three word-scrolls left to fill before the trial. Shen Wujiu watched me write and said nothing until the last stroke was dry. 'You *complete* every task as if it might be your final one,' he said, with something like respect in his voice. I tied the scrolls together. High above, the peak of the mountain vanished into sudden cloud.
complete:1.cnHint: 师兄看着我写完最后一卷字卷，说我____每件事都像在做最后一次。
complete:1.hook: The cloud swallowed the peak whole, and did not move again.
complete:1.line: 'You *complete* each scroll as though it might be your last — good.'

measure:1.en: Master Qingwu placed a slender jade rod across my open palm. 'To *measure* a herb's spiritual weight, you hold it here and count your own heartbeats,' she said. I tried with a sprig of cloud-moss. My heart beat seven times before the rod tilted. 'Seven,' she murmured. 'That is either very promising or very dangerous.'
measure:1.cnHint: 师尊教我用玉杆来____草药的灵力重量。
measure:1.hook: She did not explain which of the two she believed.
measure:1.line: 'Hold the rod still — use it to *measure* the herb's spiritual weight.'

recommend:1.en: Before the morning lesson, Xiaoxing pulled me aside. 'I *recommend* you study the word for wind-root before anyone else does,' she whispered. 'Master Qingwu mentioned it twice yesterday. That always means it appears in the trial.' She slipped a small scroll into my hand and hurried away before I could thank her. The wind picked up sharply.
recommend:1.cnHint: 小星偷偷找到我，____我在考前重点学习"风根"这个词。
recommend:1.hook: The scroll in my hand trembled, though the air had gone still.
recommend:1.line: 'I *recommend* you study wind-root tonight — trust me on this.'

resource:1.en: Shen Wujiu spread a map of the floating mountains across the stone table. 'Every mountain holds a different *resource*,' he explained. 'One grows words for healing. One grows words for speed. Master only the mountain that suits your path.' I stared at the map for a long time. One peak had no label at all, only a small ink smear shaped like an eye.
resource:1.cnHint: 师兄解释说每座山都是不同的____，蕴藏着不同类型的灵词。
resource:1.hook: The unlabelled peak seemed to shift slightly each time I looked away.
resource:1.line: 'Each mountain is a *resource* — choose the one that fits your path.'
